authoritative_direct_capture.method: cooperative direct-Panda lease; Panda(configure=False); SILENT/NOOUTPUT entry asserted; NOOUTPUT selected only if handoff heartbeat had fallen to SILENT, preserving closed relay and ACK capability; Panda power-save temporarily disabled to enable receive transceivers; can_recv only; USB heartbeat only; zero CAN data-frame submissions; no diagnostics

comparison_to_20260920_prestart_brake_wa.interpretation: The prior experiment was already in a wake-active state before the brake instruction. Today deep sleep has zero accessible CAN traffic, so 0x00F is not continuously emitted through true quiescence; an earlier entry/key/door/setup event had already started the prior visible network epoch.

conclusion.boundary: This does not prove unobserved internal vehicle segments or every ECU power rail is electrically off, and it does not identify which pre-brake event woke the September 20 network.
conclusion.implication: The comma-visible vehicle network can reach a genuinely silent deep-sleep state. The 2026-09-20 pre-brake 0x00F traffic was not an always-running deep-sleep SecOC synchronization stream.
conclusion.observed: With all three Panda CAN receive paths enabled and NOOUTPUT ACK-capable safety, the accessible Toyota networks produced zero frames for 60.002043 s; hardware RX/TX/forward/error/loss/bus-off/reset counters were unchanged on all three controllers.

operator_context.report: Vehicle had not been entered or physically interacted with during the day before this capture.

pandad_power_save_control.interpretation: Board-level control only: zero traffic while Panda power-save remained enabled. Not sufficient by itself to prove the vehicle buses were quiet because power-save disables most Panda CAN receive paths.
